### Stopping Sin in Its Tracks
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-30-2018.html
Passage: Judges 2:1
Points:
- Sin progresses in an escalating cycle from misplaced desires to defiance, disobedience, and eventual destruction.
- God's messenger journeyed from Gilgal, a monument of past deliverance, to Bochim, a place of weeping over compromise.
- Even when people face the painful consequences of their sins, God's covenant promises remain unbreakable.
- Stopping the destructive cycle of sin requires surrendering personal desires to God before they foster open rebellion.

### Telling the Next Generation
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-1-2025.html
Passage: Judges 2:1-2
Points:
- God rebuked Israel for compromising with idolatry after He had faithfully delivered and provided for them.
- Spiritual decline took root when a new generation grew up without personal knowledge of God’s past works.
- Failing to intentionally pass along testimonies of God's faithfulness leaves younger generations vulnerable to self-reliance.
- Believers must remain anchored in God's provision and actively share their faith journey with the next generation.
